title: FOO or Ramsey vs Our Wealth Plan
h1: FOO or Ramsey vs a written wealth plan
keyLine: Those maps tell the next dollar where to go. Our plan writes 12 months from your return.
description: Dave Ramsey Baby Steps and Money Guy FOO compared with Legacy Wealth Blueprint. Dated public class prices. We do not print our tuition. Written by Preston Seo.
query: Dave Ramsey vs a wealth plan
answer: Dave Ramsey's Baby Steps and the Money Guy Financial Order of Operations, or FOO, are free maps for the next dollar. Ramsey pauses extra investing until consumer debt is gone. FOO takes the employer 401(k) match earlier. Both are useful. Neither is a 12-month wealth plan. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is what Preston Seo built after a corporate job, a house-hacked duplex, and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife: one written order for tax, debt, income, investing, and protection, plus a coach and a CPA brief. Use Ramsey or FOO if cards are the fire. Use us when the leftover leak is a high W-2 bill and a full file.
criteriaIntro: The comparison pole is our wealth plan. FOO and Ramsey are two dollar-order maps, not two winners we rank against each other.

blocks.heading: Why we are in this comparison
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about) started in debt in 2017, left a corporate path, and built a $15M+ portfolio with his wife. He did not get there by picking Ramsey or FOO as a personality. He got there by putting tax, cash flow, and ownership in one system. That system is [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint).
FOO and the Baby Steps still matter. They are the cheap maps. Blueprint is the written plan plus a person on your calendar.

blocks.heading: What those two maps actually are
paragraphs: The [FOO guide](https://moneyguy.com/guide/foo/) we opened was marked last updated July 29, 2026. The nine steps are: deductibles, employer match, high-interest debt, emergency fund, Roth IRA and HSA, max employer plans, hyperaccumulation, prepay future expenses, then prepay low-interest debt. An HSA is a health savings account you can use with a high-deductible health plan.

The [Baby Steps page](https://www.ramseysolutions.com/dave-ramsey-7-baby-steps) lists: $1,000 starter fund; pay off all debt except the house with the debt snowball; three to six months of expenses; invest 15 percent for retirement; kids' college; pay the home off early; then build wealth and give. A debt snowball means you list debts from smallest balance to largest.

[Financial Peace University](https://www.ramseysolutions.com/money/financial-peace/class) is the nine-week class that teaches Ramsey's order. The class page said $99.99 per household, spouse included, on September 15, 2026. We are not ranking FPU against the FOO course. We are saying both are maps, and Blueprint is a plan.

blocks.heading: If you already earn a lot
paragraphs: A high W-2 wage does not cancel 22 percent credit cards. If those are still on, stay with Ramsey or FOO until the expensive debt is gone. Do not buy a wealth plan to skip that work.

If cards are gone and the leftover fight is a cheap mortgage versus a 401(k), that is [pay off the mortgage vs invest](/compare/mortgage-payoff-vs-investing), not a guru fight. If the leftover fight is tax on wages, that is [W-2 tax strategies](/tax-strategies/for/w2-employees) and, if you want a written order, [what's in Blueprint](/compare/legacy-wealth-blueprint-what-to-know).

blocks.label: How to read seller claims
paragraphs: Ramsey Solutions advertises average class results, such as debt paid in 90 days. Those are their marketing lines. We did not audit them. Money Guy's learn page called $49 a sale from $249. Confirm the live checkout. We do not promise any plan will make you rich.

whoFits: You finished, or almost finished, consumer debt and you are choosing a cheap map vs a written wealth plan.
You like Ramsey or FOO on spending and you need tax and investing in one order next.
whoSkips: You still have high-interest credit-card debt and no budget. Start with the free Baby Steps page or FPU, not a wealth plan.
You want us to crown FOO over Ramsey. We will not. Both are maps.

faqs.q: Should a high earner follow Ramsey or FOO?
faqs.a: Follow Ramsey's pause if lifestyle debt is still the fire. Take the 401(k) match either way. After cards are gone, neither map replaces a tax pro or a written wealth plan.
Only after expensive debt is gone. Blueprint is a 12-month plan for tax, debt, and investing together. It is not a $99.99 spending class.
